scope: Independent exact encoded sampled visual teaching review; continuous sound/native Apple pending.

lessons.reason: Concrete route and P7 comparisons persist into explicit policy/reference quantities, token masks, signed clipping, probability displacement and a three-logit payoff. Numerical operations update actual plotted values or owned operands. Exact completed-clause frames confirm the short intermediate payoffs and the separately revealed gradients, normalized probabilities, loss and release verdicts. Secondary implementation/feedback tables, long settled graph holds, brief numerical dwell and tight final loss/subheading spacing retain earned deductions. No material blocker was found.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The same station request owns two actual route responses and a route map; chosen identity persists while the clear route and detour acquire different paths.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Concrete route content makes the comparison usable. Cards settle for long clauses; the map carries more causal work late in the chapter.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The prompt stays fixed while two whole response cards exchange positions, preserving the green preferred label with its text.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Identity follows content rather than screen position. Native enlargement confirms the centered intermediate layout remains readable.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The P7 privileged-access clause makes reviewer-ticket escalation preferable to direct access; its separate proxy/win/length rehearsal remains explicitly distinct from the route toy.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The concrete request and action difference earn the choice. Secondary release numbers remain a compact table-like summary.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Reward difference 1.1 maps to a held sigmoid point and observed-label loss; reversing the actual rewards moves the point below one half and raises loss.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The observed label remains fixed while the prediction reverses. A real prediction pause precedes the point/value reveal.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Stored comparison C1 feeds exact reference-relative DPO scoring, while fresh R1/R2 rollout identities feed a reward model and PPO loop; later collection creates another comparison without rewriting C1.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Actual identities and score flow improve the usual loop diagram. Some model roles remain schematic boxes.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Actor token choices, completed-response reward, frozen reference scores and prefix critic values attach to the same three-token trajectory; a distinct old rollout snapshot owns PPO ratios.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Role and snapshot ownership are clear, but the chapter mainly constructs labeled branches rather than changing actual token probabilities or critic values.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Per-token drift charges receive one terminal score. Signed sampled log ratios form a positive weighted KL; backward residual propagation and changed lambda recalculate earlier advantages.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Exact extractions confirm the brief 0.193 payoff and both lambda results. The KL number is held only briefly before the next construction; give it more dwell in a future craft pass.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The actual surrogate curve and selected ratios expose favorable flattening for positive and negative advantages while harmful probability changes remain penalized.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Both signed branches recompute correctly. Native axes and point labels are readable; the complete curves have long explanatory holds.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Weights, gradients, moments and master bytes build a declared 16-byte inventory, then four model roles sum to 2520 decimal GB; physically removing critic state leaves 1400.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Current intermediate inventory labels match the shrinking critic bar. The later asynchronous layout is explicitly an ordering diagram rather than measured time.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Reference probabilities and exp-reward masses construct 1.5/0.5, then Z=2 and 0.75/0.25; a separate objective curve reaches its maximum at that same distribution.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Masses remain distinct from probabilities. The final objective panel is a settled explanatory graph.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The same prompt gives both reward rows an identical beta-log-Z term; those actual terms fade out together and the pairwise DPO expression remains.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Common-constant cancellation is visible rather than asserted in a footer. The formulas are compact but legible.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Chosen and rejected policy/reference scores give separate +0.6 and -0.4 changes, then their difference yields margin one.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The two response owners remain fixed. Several labels and formulas stay static once earned.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A fixed sigmoid is progressively constructed and its marker moves with the scaled beta-margin; the implied preference probability changes consistently.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The marker and displayed score remain linked. Coarse one-decimal margin labels reduce numerical precision during movement.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Normalized chosen-label probabilities produce corresponding negative-log losses, including a confidently wrong case and a confidently correct case.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The probability bars and loss update together; held examples correctly separate confidence from label truth.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A two-logit policy starts at equality, raises the chosen logit and lowers the rejected logit, recomputing both continuation softmax probabilities and DPO comparison confidence.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The policy distribution is explicitly distinct from pair confidence. Native motion follows recalculated values.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A causal row gathers the actual next target over the whole vocabulary; internal ID zero stays scored while padding zero does not. Boosting selected logits changes sums/loss; excluded predictors do not.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Native matrices, masks and exact CPU fixture values are readable. The table gives scalar outputs after the concrete target-level construction.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Four chosen 0.1 contributions and two rejected 0.15 contributions retain identity while per-response weights change from sums to means, reversing the margin.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Intermediate weights and scores are explicitly labeled weighted score, so partial construction is not presented as a completed mean.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Equal initial loss accompanies beta-dependent signed gradients; an actual two-logit step contrasts pair confidence with policy probability, and a separate ideal-population table varies beta.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Exact boundary extraction confirms the short initial-gradient payoff. The ideal-population result remains table-based with long holds.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Fixed references remain visible while chosen and rejected absolute log likelihoods both fall; the relative margin and pair loss are recomputed from those actual positions.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Continuous supplied states are labeled as a worksheet rather than a measured trajectory. The competing absolute and relative changes are clear.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: One stored A-over-B edge persists on a three-response simplex while probability mass moves toward unobserved unsafe C at unchanged A/B odds and pair loss.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The barycentric point and complete probability vector agree. A later new A/C edge is introduced without claiming that edge alone has trained a policy.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The same token IDs change only EOS inclusion; the old cached scalar is retained and a different new-mask sum is computed. A later table separates updated actor from original frozen scores.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The exact mask intervention earns invalidation. The full-model implementation caveat is a secondary static table.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A visible length-eight cut removes the distinguishing clause from both responses; a separate prompt-fills-window case has zero response targets and is dropped.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The retained positions make the failure causal rather than a checklist item. The custom-collator rule remains explicitly separate.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A declared configuration and retained artifacts distinguish executed scalar programs from a proposed transformer run; stored pair evaluation and fresh independent judgments occupy separate paths.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Correct evidence boundaries, but most secondary content is a table or two labeled panels rather than an executed training trace.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Opposite P7 votes remain separate records but move together across the prompt-group split; provenance and later behavior-coverage distinctions persist.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Actual record movement explains prompt grouping. The final behavior-risk table is secondary and static.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A shortest-answer shortcut fits all stored labels, then controlled equal-length held-out examples require semantic review; matched outcomes distinguish shortcut and updated assistant.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The concrete word changes make the evaluation purpose visible. Supplied audit outcomes are correctly labeled as fixtures.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Adding only a preamble preserves the P7 action while isolating scorer response; equal-length five/six answers and an actual before/after scalar step separate different diagnostic causes.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The changed content is concrete and length controlled. The last diagnostic table holds for a long narration clause.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The supplied 184/400 cohort builds a Wilson interval crossing one half, while a separate 48-token length bar exceeds its strict threshold.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Two independent gates remain visible and proxy gain cannot override them. These are authored data rather than observed release measurements.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The old pair archive persists while current-policy response IDs form a new reviewed edge; current-policy and reference-mixture sampling remain distinct and a biased judge reverses a new label.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Identity/provenance are useful, but sampling-mixture and judge caveats largely use schematic paths and tags.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A real quadratic target at margin five pulls an overshoot back; a complete two-answer table contrasts finite IPO target, falling sigmoid loss and bounded forward KL.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The overshoot changes the main point rather than a caption. The KL limit is correctly scoped to the complete two-answer universe.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Two complementary single-label losses share one scalar ratio and detached reference point; changing that ratio moves desirable and undesirable losses in opposite directions.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Actual points and values match their separate curves. No paired alternative is fabricated.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A one-token ORPO odds worksheet and separate SimPO average-score/margin worksheet distinguish their objective contracts; policy forward/backward remains after reference removal.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Concrete numbers distinguish the objectives, but much of the chapter relies on scalar tables and a short labeled pipeline.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Four actual rewards share a computed mean and population scale; their signed advantages reveal at a separate completed clause. Replacing all rewards with one gives zero centered advantages.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The brief nonuniform advantage payoff is confirmed by exact frames. Longer dwell and visible normalized offsets would improve the causal construction further.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Two 1.1 token ratios produce mean surrogate 1.1, while their actual product 1.21 clips to 1.2; a separate conditional-KL sample table retains its current-policy weights.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The same operands make tokenwise versus sequence clipping concrete. Versioned trainer options remain a secondary table.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A concrete P7 direct grant is critiqued and revised into escalation, followed by separate supervised/AI-feedback and independent human evaluation requirements.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The content repair is visible. Secondary RLAIF and coverage distinctions remain mostly text panels with long settled holds.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The held complete A/B/C universe receives one new A-over-C label; signed gradients move only A/C logits, then separate reveals construct normalized probabilities and a changed B probability at fixed B logit.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Fifteen native and twenty supplemental frame inspections include each completed probability/gradient/loss gate. The final green loss line sits tightly below the subheading, retaining a finish deduction without clipping.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A separately supplied 222/400 interval clears the win requirement while exactly 20 tokens fails strict growth; only the explicitly counterfactual growth changes to 19 before the pass verdict.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The held verdict and later numerical pass are separately gated. The final recap holds the earned counterfactual state rather than implying an observed deployment.

inspectedTransformations.mechanism: Preferred text and label move together through the card reorder while the prompt remains fixed.
Causal target gathering preserves an internal response ID zero while excluding padding zero; actual selected-logit changes update the whole-vocabulary sums and DPO loss.
The complete simplex moves toward unsafe C at unchanged A/B odds and observed pair loss, exposing an actually unconstrained response.

The held new A/C edge changes only its two logits, then complete probabilities reveal separately without scaling their computed values; the unchanged B logit acquires a changed normalized probability.
At growth 20 the strict length condition blocks despite the positive Wilson lower bound; the explicitly separate growth-19 counterfactual changes the main bar before its pass verdict.

quality.notes: Strong mathematical ownership and actual numerical consequences. Remaining deductions concern secondary static panels, long graph holds, short result dwell and compact caption spacing. Continuous sound performance was not assessed.

a8Review.note: Route/reorder, reward sigmoid, PPO signed curve, model inventory, gathered targets/masks, simplex, cached EOS, uniform group, fresh prediction/normalization and release were enlarged. The final loss caption sits tightly below the subheading but no sampled glyph intersection or clipped result was observed.

limits: Complete 301-line delivered narration and all 36 authored scene sheets plus brand personally read/viewed; fifteen registered native frames and twenty supplemental exact MP4 frames in ten adjacent pairboards personally inspected. The final loss frame was also enlarged at full native resolution. This is a sampled visual review rather than a continuous audiovisual watch.
Continuous sound watch, native Apple playback and publication remain pending.
No transformer/PPO/GRPO training, hosted judge, GPU benchmark or product release was executed for this encoded review; manuscript and author CPU evidence remain separate.
